name: pocket-bridge
description: An unofficial DSH-only gateway for using DeepSeek Harness on your Windows PC from a phone browser.
author: Pocket Bridge contributors

scripts._comment_test: Current DSH and shared isolated regression suite. Real desktop, phone and tunnel acceptance is separate.
scripts._comment_test_all: Discover current DSH/shared checks only; archived Codex/Dot integrations are excluded. Some DSH checks require a configured real machine; inspect their prerequisites and effects first.
scripts._comment_scan: Run before release. The default mode fails on workspace secrets and warns about history; use --strict to fail on historical findings too.
scripts._comment_prune: Retention cleanup for old runtime data. Run --dry-run first. The allowlist excludes keys, devices, and queues.
scripts._comment_ci: Isolated DSH and shared gateway checks; no Codex or Dot runtime or tests are selected.
scripts._comment_dependencies: The source has no third-party npm dependencies. The Windows installer bundles Node.js and cloudflared, but not DeepSeek Harness.

_comment_dependencies: The gateway has no third-party npm runtime dependencies. The optional DSH plugin reuses host-provided peers. Source users install Node.js and, for a temporary internet tunnel, cloudflared. The Windows installer bundles those two runtimes, but not DSH.
